title: National Museum of Bangladesh
content:
{{Short description|Museum in Dhaka, Bangladesh}} {{Use dmy dates|date=July 2013}} {{Infobox museum | name = Bangladesh National Museum | native_name = বাংলাদেশ জাতীয় জাদুঘর | native_name_lang = bn | logo = | logo_size = 100px | image = Bangladesh National Museum southern side (01).jpg | former_name = Dacca Museum | established = {{Start date and age|1913|03|20|df=yes}} | location = [[Shahbag]], Dhaka, Bangladesh | coordinates = {{Coord|23|44.25|N|90|23.67|E|region:BD_type:landmark|display=inline,title}} | website = {{URL|bangladeshmuseum.gov.bd}} | director = Md. Kamruzzaman{{Cite web|url=http://www.bangladeshmuseum.gov.bd/site/page/e511a1d3-f3c1-4fbf-809e-e7bc2ca9aeed/|title=Director General|last=Administrator|first=Super|website=bangladeshmuseum.gov.bd|language=en-gb|access-date=2022-12-24}} | map_type = | visitors = {{circa|15 million}} (including c. 1.2 million foreigners) per year }} The '''Bangladesh National Museum''' ({{lang-bn|বাংলাদেশ জাতীয় জাদুঘর}}), is the national museum of Bangladesh.{{Cite news|url=http://www.thedailystar.net/video-stories/watch-now-novera%E2%80%99s-exhibition-begins-national-museum-153904|title=[WATCH NOW] Novera's exhibition begins at National Museum|date=2015-10-08|work=The Daily Star|access-date=2017-12-19|language=en}} The museum is well organized and displays have been housed chronologically in several departments like department of [[ethnography]] and decorative art, department of history and classical art, department of natural history, and department of contemporary and world civilization. The museum also has a rich conservation laboratory. [[Nalini Kanta Bhattasali]] served as the first curator of the museum during 1914–1947.{{cite news|url=https://dev.thedailystar.net/nalini-kanta-bhattasalis-67th-death-anniversary-observed-13327|title=Nalini Kanta Bhattasali's 67th death anniversary observed|date=28 February 2014|access-date=12 August 2017|newspaper=The Daily Star|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170812211645/https://dev.thedailystar.net/nalini-kanta-bhattasalis-67th-death-anniversary-observed-13327|archive-date=12 August 2017|url-status=dead}} [[File:Rishabhdeva at Bangladesh National Museum.png|thumb|150px|The idol of [[Rishabhanatha|Rishabhdeva]] in seated posture in display.]] == History == [[File:National Museum1.JPG|thumb|Bangladesh National Museum designed by [[Syed Mainul Hossain]]]] Bangladesh National Museum was originally established on 20 March 1913, albeit under another name (Dacca Museum), and formally inaugurated on 7 August 1913 by [[Thomas Gibson-Carmichael, 1st Baron Carmichael|The Lord Carmichael]], the governor of Bengal. In July 1915 it was handed over to the [[Naib Nazim of Dhaka]].{{Cite news|url=http://www.thedailystar.net/news/eventful-innings|title=Eventful Innings|date=2013-08-07|work=The Daily Star|access-date=2017-12-19|language=en}} Bangladesh National Museum was formed through the incorporation of Dhaka museum and it was made the national museum of Bangladesh on 17 November 1983. It is located at Shahbag, Dhaka.{{Cite web|url=http://bangladeshmuseum.gov.bd/site/|title=Welcome to Bangladesh National Museum|website=bangladeshmuseum.gov.bd|language=en-gb|access-date=2017-12-19|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171028002758/http://bangladeshmuseum.gov.bd/site/|archive-date=28 October 2017|url-status=dead}} == Ground floor == The ground floor consists of some old guns at the entrance and the hall where the people book their tickets or assemble to hear the history of the museum. The hall leads to a grand staircase. Beside the hall, there is a smaller room which also acts like the hall (it is also used by the guides to tell the visitors about the history) and a simple staircase. == First floor == The first floor is divided into 22 rooms. === First room === The first room displays a large map showing the map of [[Bangladesh]] and its 64 districts. === Second room === The second room consists of a large statue of a [[royal Bengal tiger]]. ===Third-tenth rooms === These rooms consist of natural beauties found in Bangladesh. In one of the room there is showcase of a tongue of a whale. === Tenth-22nd rooms === The other rooms contain some historic relics of Bengal up to 1900. There is a room which shows the different boats used by the rural people. == Second floor == The second floor consists of photos of famous people and showcases the [[Bangladesh Liberation War]] and the [[Bengali language movement|Language Movement]] of 1952. There are posters used in the war, a torture machine and much more. There are also two libraries. == Third floor == The third floor consists of pictures of international politicians, artists, scientists, famous pictures and four international galleries - Chinese, Korean, Iranian and Swiss.{{cite web |url=http://www.bangladeshmuseum.gov.bd/index.php/2012-10-10-12-30-29/gallery-floor-plan |title=Gallery Floor Plan |access-date=2014-09-09 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140830070416/http://www.bangladeshmuseum.gov.bd/index.php/2012-10-10-12-30-29/gallery-floor-plan |archive-date=30 August 2014 |df=dmy-all }} ==Gallery== Image:Composition by Novera Ahmed.jpg|Composition,
